summary: Nine-metre school-front kerb, too steep and signed no stopping at school times.
reasons: Under a van length of usable kerb

drivers.seclusion: School buildings and a vet clinic beside it, no homes within 10 m, but the road is busy at school times.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 9 m of kerb, broken by a driveway; not enough for a van and steep.
drivers.traffic: School-run road with heavy traffic at drop-off and pick-up.
drivers.convention: No Stopping signs 7-9am and school-day afternoons; 1/4P on school days; no overnight parking convention.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb, from the north and west.
